scientific_integrity: The direct finite checks are examples, not an all-parameter proof. The character-degree orbit method and affine splitting are known techniques; the assessed potentially new assertion is the complete two-family conjugacy-class-size distribution over arbitrary finite chain rings. Priority remains subject to further literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Conjugacy is internal to upper-triangular unit groups over finite commutative chain rings of length at least two; no general non-chain rings, higher matrix sizes, ambient similarity, individual character values, or independence certification is claimed.
title: Universal class-size and character-degree spectra of two-by-two Borel groups over finite chain rings
